notes: MiniMax M2.7 INT4 AutoRound served through an OpenAI-compatible vLLM/XPU endpoint on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70. After moving display duty to onboard ASPEED VGA and booting with xe.disable_display=1, vLLM serves max_model_len=32768. Near-full context request with 32408 prompt tokens plus 64 generated tokens completed without OOM; conservative prompt rate was 1625.5 prompt tok/s. Warm short decode after the near-full request measured 1536 output tokens in 18.259s = 84.12 output tok/s. 33792 was tested but did not expose /v1/models within the wait window, so 32768 is the promoted reliable served context. No speculative decoding, no expert dropping, no model/quantization change, no power-limit change. Strict quality gates for this deployable stack passed before benchmarking.
